verdict.rationale: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is a law firm offering legal advisory services. Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for agents is a software-platform capability, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm offers any public API or developer platform. Its internal use of AI legaltech and its Prarambh incubator do not make it an API provider.
